_comment: Fine topology-optimisation runs. Each entry: Setup parameters for analysis/topo.py plus t_min (manufacturing minimum wall, enforced on the output geometry) and verify_h (tet size for the full-accuracy check). Loads: radial press + diametral pinch only (20 N, full width, several angles) - no edge, lip or axial loads. Objective: minimum rotational inertia; constraint: von Mises <= 0.9 x (UTS/2) everywhere. n_phi = load angles per symmetry sector, set for ~10 deg spacing (a coarse reference run with 20 deg spacing over-fitted to the sampled angles and failed the full check at the angles in between).

runs.name: r05_N6_skin0.4
runs.note: thinner skin for a process that can print 0.4 mm walls (e.g. MJF / fine SLA); still SLS PA12 properties
